key_positions.stance: Supports expanding and investing in recreation facilities (pickleball courts, cricket pitches, splash pads, disc golf, skate parks) rather than closing or cannibalizing existing ones.
Opposes closing recreation facilities such as Weston Arena, and opposes cutting Dentonia Park Golf Course in half.
Supports keeping parks clean, accessible, and safe for families, including keeping pools and park washrooms open in summer.
Opposes tent encampments in parks and playgrounds and supports clearing encampments while connecting people with supports.
Supports protecting Toronto's ravines, tree canopy, and ecologically-sensitive areas including Small's Creek from infrastructure impacts.
Supports climate action including net-zero-by-2040 target, EV charging infrastructure expansion, district energy, and TransformTO.
Opposes the toboggan ban and supports common-sense safety mitigation measures to allow outdoor winter activities.
Supports permitting responsible alcohol consumption in select parks.
Opposes the current administration's approach of hiring more Parks staff without accountability, arguing performance and management should come first.
Supports protecting waterfront by creating a motorized watercraft exclusion zone at Woodbine Beach while welcoming paddleboards and kayaks.
